newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee slips to 35.94 vs dlr in late trading.
newsitem.headline: India rupee slips to 35.94 vs dlr in late trading.

text.p: The Indian rupee slipped to 35.945/965 on Thursday evening deals as several banks followed the lead of a major Calcutta-based bank which went on a dollar buying spree, dealers said.
"There were deals upto 35.9450 today," said a dealer.
He said the rupee began to fall after the Calcutta bank hit the market with buy orders but other banks soon joined the fray.
Dealers said the Calcutta bank appeared to be partnering the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) offensive to beef up dollar reserves ahead of the redemption of India Development Bond (IDB) on Friday.
The RBI was buying dollars in the swap market, pulling down premia for August dollars to 1.35/1.38 rupees from 1.38/1.41 opening level, dealers said.
